ontologyImport.fileHelp: An Apache Ossie model, an RDF/OWL file (Turtle, RDF/XML, N-Triples or JSON-LD), or a whole release as a .zip of its module files.
ontologyImport.formatHelp: Needed only when the file's name does not say its format.
ontologyImport.domainsHelp: The domains the terms this import makes belong to. Only domains you curate are offered.
ontologyImport.noImports: No ontology has been imported yet.
ontologyImport.noItems: No items of this kind match.
ontologyImport.noAlignments: Nothing proposed: applied, it becomes a Concept until it aligns.
ontologyImport.name: Name
ontologyImport.renameHelp: The term's name in the glossary once applied.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_iri: The term already carries this item's IRI.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_name: The term has the item's name.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_qualified_name: The item is a property of a class here, and the class's name with the property's names the term.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_normalized_name: The names match once both are put in the glossary's normal form.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_synonym: One of the item's labels names the term.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_head_noun: One name ends with the other: the narrower is likely a kind of the wider.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_qualifier: The term's name begins with the item's: the term is likely a property of it.
ontologyImport.basisHelp_ontology: The ontology itself states this relationship between two of its items.
ontologyImport.useDefinitionHelp: The term takes the imported definition in place of its own. A term with no definition takes it anyway.
ontologyImport.applyIntro: Applying writes the import to the glossary as a whole, or not at all. What it will do:
ontologyImport.previewSameAs_one: item is aligned with an existing term, which takes its IRI
ontologyImport.previewSameAs_other: items are aligned with existing terms, which take their IRIs
ontologyImport.previewEdges_one: approved alignment is written as a relationship
ontologyImport.previewEdges_other: approved alignments are written as relationships
ontologyImport.previewWaiting_one: approved alignment waits: an end of it is excluded
ontologyImport.previewWaiting_other: approved alignments wait: an end of each is excluded
ontologyImport.previewExcluded_one: item is excluded and left out
ontologyImport.previewExcluded_other: items are excluded and left out
ontologyImport.previewUndecided_one: proposal is undecided and stays as it is
ontologyImport.previewUndecided_other: proposals are undecided and stay as they are
ontologyImport.applyRefused_one: Nothing was applied. {{count}} problem to resolve first:
ontologyImport.applyRefused_other: Nothing was applied. {{count}} problems to resolve first:
ontologyImport.appliedDone: Applied: {{created}} terms made, {{aligned}} aligned, {{edges}} relationships written
ontologyImport.discardConsequence: The import and its proposals are removed. Terms it made and relationships it wrote stay in the glossary.
ontologyImport.curatedByIri: Aligned with an imported concept: the term is kept when its columns leave the model.
